interfere.cn: 这些变化严重到足以干扰社会或职业功能。
interfere.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

internal.en: Europe has abolished many internal borders.
internal.cn: 欧洲已经废除了许多内部边界。
internal.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 听力

interpret.en: Instead, they have decided to interpret how the Industrial Revolution was affected by other events.
interpret.cn: 相反，他们决定解读工业革命如何受到其他事件的影响。
interpret.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

interpretation.en: By influencing our interpretation of symbolic messages.
interpretation.cn: 通过影响我们对符号信息的解读。
interpretation.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

interrupt.en: It interrupted traffic for several hours running.
interrupt.cn: 它导致交通中断持续数小时。

interval.en: She'd wake up early, turn on her laptop and chat on Internet dating sites and instant-messaging programs – leaving her bed for only brief intervals.
interval.cn: 她会很早就起床，然后打开笔记本电脑在网络交友网站和即时通信软件上聊天，中间只会离开床一会会儿。
interval.source: 2010年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

intimate.en: Using voice interaction feels far more intimate than surfing the net the old-fashioned way.
intimate.cn: 使用语音交互比用老式的方式上网要亲密得多。
intimate.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

investment.en: They would improve remarkably with more research and investment .
investment.cn: 只要投入更多研究和资金，它们将会有显著的改善。

invisible.en: It creates a kind of cognitive blindness — all of the factors external to a person’s drive and choices that they've made become invisible and fade from view.
invisible.cn: 它造成了一种认知盲点ーー所有外在于个人努力和选择的因素都变得无足轻重，从人们的视野中消失。
invisible.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

involvement.en: But their purpose was limited to providing money for urgent government crises, such as American involvement in the war of 1812.
involvement.cn: 但它们的目的仅限于为紧急的政府危机提供资金，比如美国卷入1812年的战争。
involvement.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

irrational.en: People can be so irrational sometimes.
irrational.cn: 人们有时候就是会这么不理性。
irrational.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

irrigation.en: Until genetic engineering comes to fruition, other strategies might also help in some places, including applying more fertilizer, implementing better irrigation, using machinery that gets crops out of the field faster or installing storage facilities to delay spoilage.
irrigation.cn: 在等待基因工程硕果的同时，其他一些策略或许也能在特定地区发挥作用，诸如增加施肥量、改进灌溉系统、采用加快作物收割的机械化作业，或者建立储藏设施以减缓食品腐败。
irrigation.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

item.en: Well, you’d expect the Design Museum to commission and make some interesting items, but this one was different.
item.cn: 当然，人们会期待设计博物馆委托制作一些有趣的物品，但这件作品却与众不同。
item.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

jail.en: Some of my friends went to jail. Some were killed.
jail.cn: 我的一些朋友坐了牢，一些被杀害。
jail.source: 2020年7月英语四级 第1套 听力

jealousy.en: Although the negative emotions associated with romantic love-fear of loss, disappointment and jealousy-are fairly consistent across cultures, the positive feelings can vary.
jealousy.cn: 尽管与浪漫爱情相关的负面情绪——害怕失去、失望和嫉妒——在不同文化中相当一致，但积极的情感却可能有所不同。
jealousy.source: 2013年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

jeans.en: What does the man say about Japanese jeans at the end of the conversation?
jeans.cn: 对话最后，这位男士对日本牛仔裤说了些什么？
jeans.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

jog.en: And when joggers jog, they don't run the streets.
jog.cn: 慢跑者在慢跑时，并不会去街上跑。

joint.en: Joint efforts to improve the local community.
joint.cn: 共同努力改善当地社区。
joint.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

journal.en: The study, published Wednesday in the journal Neurology, couldn't prove that exercise prevented dementia, and the findings aren't a surprise — it's long been known there's a correlation between exercise and decreased dementia risk — but the results were particularly dramatic.
journal.cn: 这项研究发表在周三的《神经病学》杂志上，虽然无法证明运动可以预防痴呆，结果也并不令人意外——人们早已知道运动与降低痴呆风险之间存在联系——但结果尤为显著。
journal.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

jungle.en: Visitors had a similar effect on some other species too, including polar bears, certain jungle cats and black-tailed plain dogs.
jungle.cn: 访客对包括北极熊、某些丛林猫和黑尾原野犬在内的一些其他物种也产生了类似影响。
jungle.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

junior.en: I designed an eight-session workshop for 91 students whose math grades were declining in their first year of junior high.
junior.cn: 我为91名初中一年级数学成绩下滑的学生设计了一个为期八节的研讨会。其中48名学生只接受了学习技巧方面的指导，而其他学生则参加了学习技巧课程和成长型思维模式课程相结合的学习，在课程中他们学习了成长型思维模式以及如何将其应用于学校作业。
junior.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

jury.en: For now, the jury is still out as to how successful those endeavors will be.
jury.cn: 至于这些尝试能否成功，目前仍未有明确的结论。
jury.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

justice.en: Where justice is concerned, there is also a huge divide.
justice.cn: 司法领域也存在着巨大的鸿沟。
justice.source: 2015年6月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

justify.en: The gasoline tax, for instance, is sometimes justified using the benefits principle.
justify.cn: 例如，使用受益原则征收的石油税有时也是合理的。
justify.source: 2014年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

label.en: This is in contrast to books that did not name images or books that had the same label under each image.
label.cn: 这和没有给图像命名的图书或每个图像下都是相同标签的图书形成了对比。

laborious.en: Entering the world of Tarahumaras has been a laborious project for Copeland.
laborious.cn: 进入塔拉乌马拉人的世界对科普兰来说是一项费时费力的工程。
laborious.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

lag.cn: 联邦医疗保险远远落后。
lag.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

landscape.en: Large education bureaucracies and unions came to dominate the landscape, confusing activity with achievement.
landscape.cn: 大型教育官僚机构和工会开始去控制这个形势，它们把成就和活动混淆。
landscape.source: 2014年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

largely.en: One's behavior is largely determined by their genetic traits.
largely.cn: 一个人的行为在很大程度上由其遗传特征所决定。
largely.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

last.en: Sales of grass-fed yogurt and kefir on the other hand, have in the last year increased by over 38%.
last.cn: 另一方面，草饲酸奶和克菲尔的销售额在去年增长了38%以上。
last.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

layout.en: The typical supermarket layout has barely changed over the past 90 years.
layout.cn: 在过去的90年里，超市的典型布局几乎没有改变。
layout.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

lead.en: "There is a large potential for wastewater agriculture to both help and hurt great numbers of urban consumers," said Liqa Raschid-Sally, who led the study.
lead.cn: “污水农业给城市的众多消费者带来帮助和伤害的可能性都很大。”牵头这项研究的利卡·拉希德-萨莉说道。
lead.source: 2016年6月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

leading.en: Nigel Goode is a leading aviation designer who works at a company which has been delivering aircraft interiors for airlines for 30 years.
leading.cn: 奈杰尔·古德是一位杰出的航空设计师，他所在的公司已经为航空公司提供飞机内饰30年了。
leading.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第2套 阅读

learning.en: It happens when the parts of your brain used for learning, memory, decision making, and language are damaged or diseased.
learning.cn: 当大脑中用于学习、记忆、决策和语言的部分受到损伤或疾病影响时，痴呆就会发生。
learning.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

lease.en: Food-import anxiety is even leading to new efforts by food-importing countries to buy or lease farmland in other countries.
lease.cn: 对于食品进口的焦虑甚至正在促使粮食进口国做出新的努力：在其他国家购买或租赁土地。

legend.en: "There's an ancient legend that as long as these eggs are made, evil will not prevail in the world," says Joan Brander, a Canadian egg-painter who has been painting eggs for over 60 years, having learned the art from her Ukrainian relatives.
legend.cn: “有一个古老的传说，只要做好了这些鸡蛋，恶魔就不会在世间横行。”琼·布兰德说，她是一位已经画了60多年鸡蛋的加拿大鸡蛋绘画者，她从乌克兰亲戚那里学会了这门艺术。
legend.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

legislation.en: There’s a lot on the internet about a state-wide ban in Florida, but a few days worth of digging by a historian at the Florida State Historical Society found no such legislation.
legislation.cn: 网上很多人说佛罗里达州全州禁用金属饭盒，但是佛罗里达州历史协会的一位历史学家经过几天的搜索并没有发现这样的立法。
legislation.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

leisure.en: In a new paper, Friedman tries to figure out why that increased productivity has not translated into increased leisure time.
leisure.cn: 在一篇新论文中，Friedman试图探究为什么提升的生产效率并未转变为更多的休闲时间。

lens.en: Seen through the lens of the present self versus the future self, our self-defeating actions—like choosing to watch television rather than go to the gym—suddenly make perfect sense.
lens.cn: 从现在和未来的自我角度来看，我们那些自我挫败的行为——比如选择看电视而不是去健身房——突然显得合情合理。

lest.en: Some say we should never meet our heroes, lest they disappoint us when we find out how normal they are.
lest.cn: 有人说我们不应该与自己的偶像见面，以免发现他们其实很普通，从而感到失望。

liability.en: Among the reasons given for the decision, the restaurant cited noise levels, lack of space for high chairs, cleaning up extreme messes, and the liability of kids running around the restaurant.
liability.cn: 餐厅给出的理由包括：噪音过大、没有足够空间摆放儿童高脚椅、需要清理严重的脏乱，以及儿童在餐厅内乱跑可能引发的安全责任问题。
liability.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

liberal.en: The liberal arts in higher education help enrich students' spiritual life.
liberal.cn: 高等教育中的博雅教育有助于丰富学生的精神生活。
liberal.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

liberate.en: Before we collectively tear our hair out — how are we supposed to find our way in a landscape this confusing?— here is a thought from Dr. Philip Sloane, a geriatrician at the University of North Carolina: “In a way, that could be liberating for families.”
liberate.cn: 在我们集体绞尽脑汁，想在这种混乱不堪的状态下找出一条光明大道之前，北卡莱罗纳大学的老年病学专家菲利普·斯隆博士一语中的：“从某种意义上来说，这对于家庭而言是一种解放。”
liberate.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

likewise.en: Likewise, the of this warming will be very different depending on where you are—coastal areas must worry about rising sea levels, while Siberia and northern Canada may become more habitable and for humans than these areas are now.
likewise.cn: 同样，这种变暖的影响也会因地域而异——沿海地区必须担心海平面上升，而西伯利亚和加拿大北部可能会变得比现在更适宜人类居住。
likewise.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

linear.en: Logical learners have a linear mind and would rather use logic, reasoning, and systems.
linear.cn: 逻辑性学习者拥有线性顺序的思维，更喜欢使用逻辑，推理，以及系统。
linear.source: 2022年6月大学英语四级考试真题

literacy.en: There are undoubtedly hundreds of great resources out there for those wishing to improve their financial literacy, but while I was researching, I still kept wishing that I didn’t have to play catch-up with the money world.
literacy.cn: 毫无疑问，对于那些想提高理财能力的人来说，外面有数不胜数的优质资源。不过，在我查阅资料的过程中，我还是忍不住希望自己不必在理财方面从零开始追赶。
literacy.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

literary.en: Such literary accomplishments highlight an important point.
literary.cn: 这些文学成就凸显了一个重要事实。
literary.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

literature.en: “I'm very keen to encourage young people,” she says, observing that design brings together other subjects such as literature, art, history, geography and science.
literature.cn: "我非常希望能激励年轻人，"她说，并指出设计能够融合文学、艺术、历史、地理和科学等多个学科。
literature.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

litter.en: They are not having their litter collected properly or the dustbins emptied.
litter.cn: 他们没有正确地收集垃圾或清理垃圾箱。

loan.en: One big reason they're struggling is attributed to college loans, of which the average amounts to $37,000.
loan.cn: 他们面临困境的一个重要原因是大学贷款，其平均额度达到了37,000美元。
loan.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

locate.en: Karen is the managing director of Cube Movie Theatre located on Underhill Road.
locate.cn: 凯伦是Cube电影院的常务董事，Cube电影院位于安德希尔路。
locate.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 听力

lodge.en: Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
lodge.cn: 凌晨3:30，我和九岁的女儿坐在小屋阳台上彻夜未眠，我凝视着这辈子见过的最美的夜空，直到黎明慢慢开始抹去天边的星星，许多流星也渐渐消失。
lodge.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

lodging.en: Schools should be cautious when making decisions about student lodging.
lodging.cn: 学校在处理学生住宿问题时应该小心谨慎。
lodging.source: 2011年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

log.en: Research from the exhaustive study of groundwater from over 950 drilling logs has just been published.
log.cn: 一项对超过 950 个钻井记录的地下水进行详尽研究的成果刚刚发表。
log.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

logical.en: Dementia, as defined in medical dictionaries, is a broad term that describes a loss of thinking ability, memory, attention, logical reasoning, and other mental abilities.
logical.cn: 医学词典中定义的痴呆，是一个广泛的术语，用于描述思维能力、记忆力、注意力、逻辑推理和其他精神能力的丧失。
logical.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

loosen.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

lot.en: But it takes a lot more than a nearby airport to be a city of the future.
lot.cn: 但要成为未来城市，需要的不仅仅是附近的机场。
lot.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（二）

lower.en: The district said the decreased budget means it cannot provide the same mental health supports, social and emotional services or specialized programming to schools with lower enrollments.
lower.cn: 学区表示，预算减少意味着无法为入学人数较少的学校提供同等的心理健康支持、社会和情感服务或专业化课程。
lower.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

luxury.en: Luxury goods target our feelings of self-worth, acceptance, and status in the world.
luxury.cn: 奢侈品迎合了我们对自我价值、认同感和社会地位的追求。
luxury.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

machinery.en: Until genetic engineering comes to fruition, other strategies might also help in some places, including applying more fertilizer, implementing better irrigation, using machinery that gets crops out of the field faster or installing storage facilities to delay spoilage.
machinery.cn: 在等待基因工程硕果的同时，其他一些策略或许也能在特定地区发挥作用，诸如增加施肥量、改进灌溉系统、采用加快作物收割的机械化作业，或者建立储藏设施以减缓食品腐败。
machinery.source: 2023年12月大学英语四级考试真题

magnetic.en: The store's card reader failed to scan the card's magnetic strip.
magnetic.cn: 商店的读卡器没能扫描出卡片的磁条。

magnificent.en: Formula One teams race far more technologically advanced vehicles around tracks all over the world—in magnificent events in places like Malaysia, Monaco, Singapore and the United Arab Emirates, and on tradition-rich tracks like Silverstone in England and Monza in Italy too.
magnificent.cn: 一级方程式车队在世界各地的赛道上驾驶技术更先进的车辆——例如在马来西亚、摩纳哥、新加坡和阿联酋的盛大赛事，以及英格兰的银石和意大利的蒙扎等富有传统的赛道。
magnificent.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

maintain.en: Though the study mentioned above was fairly small (only 191 women took the initial fitness test, which means it's hard to maintain statistical significance while breaking the group down into sub-categories of more or less fit), …
maintain.cn: 尽管上述研究规模较小（只有191名女性参加了最初的健身测试，这意味着在将群体细分为不同健康水平的子类别时难以保持统计显著性）……
maintain.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

maintenance.en: For example, men liked yard care and home maintenance more than women.
maintenance.cn: 例如，男性比女性更倾向于喜欢园艺和家庭维修。
maintenance.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

majority.en: But whatever the type of animal, the vast majority of owners said their pets boosted their mental and physical health.
majority.cn: 但无论是哪种动物，绝大多数宠物主人都表示，他们的宠物提升了自己的心理和身体健康。
majority.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

mammal.en: Compared with other mammals, our numerical instincts are not as remarkable as many assume.
mammal.cn: 与其他哺乳动物相比，我们的数字本能并不像许多人认为的那样出色。
mammal.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

management.en: Through better water management and farming practices, water usage in cotton production can be cut down by nearly 40 percent.
management.cn: 通过更好的水管理和耕作措施，棉花生产中的用水量可以减少近40%。

manipulate.en: Two dancers coordinate their movements, one manipulating the lion's head and the other its body.
manipulate.cn: 两个舞者协调他们的动作，一个操纵狮头，另一个操纵狮身。
manipulate.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

margin.en: When good students turn in an essay, they dream of their instructor returning it to them in exactly the same condition, save for a single word added in the margin of the final page: "Flawless."
margin.cn: 当好学生们交上一篇文章时，他们都梦想着自己的导师能原封不动地返回给他们，只在文章最后一页的空白处写着四个字：“毫无瑕疵”。
margin.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

marine.en: Back in 1974, only 10% of marine fish stocks had been overfished.
marine.cn: 早在1974年，只有10%的海洋鱼类资源被过度捕捞。
marine.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

marshal.en: The Norwalk Fire Marshal is investigating the cause and origin of the fire.
marshal.cn: 诺沃克消防队长正在调查这场火灾的原因和起点。
marshal.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

marvel.en: They were such strange marvels that, on her first official state visit to the United States in 1957, Queen Elizabeth II insisted on an impromptu tour of a suburban-Maryland Giant Food.
marvel.cn: 这些新事物非常让人惊异，女王伊丽莎白二世1957年对美国进行第一次正式国事访问时，坚持即兴参观位于马里兰郊区的巨人食品超市。
marvel.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

mass.en: The capacity to mass produce it.
mass.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

mate.en: Experts say too much happiness can stop the bears from searching for new mates.
mate.cn: 专家指出，过度舒适的环境可能会阻碍熊寻找新伴侣的行为。
mate.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

mathematics.en: Researchers said they investigated individuals' attitudes towards mathematics because of what could be referred to as a mathematics crisis in the UK.
mathematics.cn: 研究人员表示，他们研究个人对于数学的态度是因为英国出现了所谓的数学危机。
mathematics.source: 2021年6月大学英语四级考试真题

mature.en: I admit the academic record is very strong, with many outstanding awards for achievements in science and math, but he is just not mature enough to live on his own at this point.
mature.cn: 我承认他的学业成绩确实非常优秀,在科学和数学方面获得了许多杰出奖项,但现阶段他还不够成熟,无法独立生活。
mature.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

maximum.en: Adaptive cruise control is a driver assistance technology that sets a maximum speed for vehicles and automatically slows the speed of the car when traffic is sensed in front of the vehicle.
maximum.cn: 自适应巡航控制是一种驾驶辅助技术，它为车辆设定最高速度，并在探测到前方有车时自动降低车速。
maximum.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

mayor.en: What did mayor Takashi Kawamura offer to do?
mayor.cn: 川村隆史市长提出了什么方案？
mayor.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

measurement.en: For statistics, we should invest in more accurate measurement options.
measurement.cn: 于统计而言，我们应该采取更精确的计量方法选项。
measurement.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

mechanic.en: Has the mechanic called the bus repairers?
mechanic.cn: 修车工联系过公交车修理厂吗？
mechanic.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

mechanical.en: A mechanical engineer said, “It will give you the flexibility to do almost anything.“
mechanical.cn: 一位机械工程师表示："工程师这个职业能让你拥有极大的灵活性，几乎可以胜任任何工作。"
mechanical.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

mechanics.en: At the time, I am sure she thought she was teaching me about mechanics, transitions, structure, style and voice.
mechanics.cn: 当时，我确信她认为自己正在教给我有关技巧、过渡、文章结构、写作风格和语态的知识。
mechanics.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

medium.en: About 5% of the women with the highest peak workload — those who were able to bike the hardest over those 6 minutes — developed dementia, compared to 25% of those with medium fitness and 45% who weren't fit enough to finish the test, the study found.
medium.cn: 研究发现，最高负荷能力的女性中约有5%患上痴呆症，相比之下，中等健身水平的女性中有25%患病，而未能完成测试的女性中有45%患病。
medium.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

melt.en: It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted; it could be melted for use in other products.
melt.cn: 法院下令销毁所有仿制兔子，但建议不必浪费巧克力；可以将其融化后用于制作其他产品。
melt.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

membership.en: She didn't sign up for membership in time.
membership.cn: 她没能及时办理会员手续。

memorial.en: I've gotten them from medieval saints, maps, dictionaries, plants, war memorials, and people I've met!
memorial.cn: 我从中世纪的圣人、地图、字典、植物、战争纪念碑以及我遇到的人那里都得到过它们！
memorial.source: 2006年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

mental.en: The district said the decreased budget means it cannot provide the same mental health supports, social and emotional services or specialized programming to schools with lower enrollments.
mental.cn: 学区表示，预算减少意味着无法为入学人数较少的学校提供同等的心理健康支持、社会和情感服务或专业化课程。
mental.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

mentality.en: The fascinating thing about being human is that generally we are unaware that there are changes taking place in our mentality.
mentality.cn: 作为人类很有趣的一点是，我们通常都没有意识到我们的心理正在发生变化。
mentality.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

mere.en: A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space makes us uncomfortable.
mere.cn: 一个只是泛泛之交的人进入我们的亲密空间，会让我们感觉不自在。
mere.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

merit.en: As a student from a family that is struggling to make ends meet, my financial aid package is a combination of federal grants and federal work study, university merit scholarships and financial aid awards, and about $8,000 yearly in federally subsidized and unsubsidized loans.
merit.cn: 作为一个入不敷出的家庭的学生，我的经济援助计划包括联邦助学金和联邦勤工俭学项目、大学优异奖学金和助学金，以及每年大约8000美元的联邦补贴和非补贴贷款。
merit.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

messenger.en: Muscle performance can also be affected by a phenomenon called “central fatigue”, in which an imbalance in the body’s chemical messengers prevents the central nervous system from directing muscle movements effectively.
messenger.cn: 肌肉的活动还会被一种名为“中枢疲劳”的现象影响，即身体化学传输系统的不平衡会阻碍中枢神经系统有效地指挥肌肉运动。
messenger.source: 2017年6月大学英语四级考试真题（二）

metric.en: Director of Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation Chris Murray it as an "urgent call to action."
metric.cn: 健康指标与评估研究所所长克里斯·默里将其称为“紧急行动呼吁”。
metric.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

microphone.en: The only thing left to do is set up the microphones and speakers.
microphone.cn: 剩下的唯一工作就是架设麦克风和扬声器。

migrate.en: "A lot of birds have migrated to the area and one doesn't need to travel long hours anymore or go to other lakes to watch the birds," says Ion Meuta, Deputy Mayor of Mahmudia.
migrate.cn: 马赫穆迪亚副市长扬 · 默塔说：“很多鸟类已经迁徙到这个地区，人们不再需要长途旅行或者到其他湖泊去观鸟了。”
migrate.source: 2020年7月英语四级 第1套 听力

military.en: The police assured everyone that it was just thunder and lightning rather than some military exercise.
military.cn: 警方向公众澄清，这只是雷电交加的自然现象，并非什么军事演习。
military.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

milky.en: Beginning their astronomical PowerPoint demonstration using a green laser pointer, Hilde and Orla showed us the Messier 4 spherical cluster with white dwarf stars, Saturn and its rings, the Southern Cross and the Milky Way, which stretched across the sky.
milky.cn: 希尔德和奥拉使用绿色激光笔开始了他们的天文PowerPoint演示，向我们展示了梅西耶4球状星团及其中的白矮星、土星及其光环、南十字座和横亘天际的银河。

mill.en: But it turns out Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools used to make jeans the original way.
mill.cn: 但它揭示出，日本仍然有一些非常古老的工厂使用传统编织工具，以最开始的方式生产牛仔裤。
mill.source: 2023年6月大学英语四级考试真题（一）

mine.en: She recalls: One day a man I worked with, Ryan, who had his office next to mine, said, "Leah, let's go look at this space on Queen Anne."
mine.cn: 她回忆道：有一天，我隔壁办公室的男同事瑞安说：“利娅，我们去看看安妮女王这个位置吧。”
mine.source: 2017年6月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

minimize.en: It minimizes the use of controversial pesticides in its operations.
minimize.cn: 它在经营中尽量减少使用存在争议的农药。
minimize.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

minor.en: Minor setbacks in their early career may have a strong negative effect on the career of close losers.
minor.cn: 职业生涯早期的小挫折可能会对那些惜败者的职业生涯产生严重的负面影响。
minor.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

minority.en: It produces clothes affordable only to a tiny minority .
minority.cn: 它生产的服装只有极少数人买得起。

miracle.en: Often, the 'boring things' may not be boring at all. Maybe they are actually little miracles, he says.
miracle.cn: “很多情况下，所谓‘无趣的东西’可能非但一点也不无趣，实际上还是小小的奇迹。”他说道。
miracle.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

miserable.en: Getting old is by no means something miserable.
miserable.cn: 变老绝不是一件痛苦的事。
miserable.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

missing.en: They determined that this was because other parts of his brain took over the missing part's visual tasks.
missing.cn: 他们认定这是因为他大脑的其他部分承担了缺失部位的视觉功能。

mission.en: Today, the Earth Day Network, which rallies more than 20,000 partners and organizations in 190 countries, supports the Earth Day mission year-round.
mission.cn: 今天,地球日网络在190个国家联合了超过2万个合作伙伴和组织,全年支持地球日的使命。

mixer.en: A mixer can save so much time in making cakes.
mixer.cn: 搅拌机可以节省很多做蛋糕的时间。
mixer.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

modest.en: That means we need modest, realistic expectations, and we need to teach people to cook food that's good enough to share with family and friends.
modest.cn: 这意味着我们需要适度的、现实的期望，而且我们需要教人们把饭菜做得足够好来与家人和朋友一同分享。
modest.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

moist.en: They should be able to be read by a machine at temperatures ranging from 10 degrees Celsius to 50 degrees Celsius, under the conditions where the air can be extremely dry or moist.
moist.cn: 它们应该能够在10摄氏度到50摄氏度的温度下，在空气极其干燥或潮湿的条件下被机器读取。
moist.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

mold.en: If your goal is to have standardized approaches to learning, where everybody learns the same thing at the same time in the same way, then learning by doing doesn't really fit that mold anymore.
mold.cn: 如果你的目标是采用标准化的学习方法，让每个人都能在同一时间以相同的方式学习相同的内容，那么边做边学就不再符合这种模式了。
mold.source: 2019年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

monstrous.en: The monstrous pearl, measured at 1 foot wide and 2.2 feet long, is going to be verified by local experts and international authorities before hopefully going on display to attract more tourists in the little town.
monstrous.cn: 这颗巨大的珍珠宽1英尺，长2.2英尺，将由本地专家和国际权威机构检测，然后有望在这个小城里展览，以吸引更多游客。
monstrous.source: 2020年12月大学英语四级考试真题

monument.en: What is the roadside monument I see on my way to work everyday?
monument.cn: 我每天上班路上看到的路边的纪念碑是什么？
monument.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

moral.en: For as long as there are homeless people, there is a tendency to blame the victims themselves for their condition—to see their failure to thrive as an issue of character, of moral weakness, of laziness.
moral.cn: 因为只要有无家可归的人，就有将他们的状况归咎于受害者自己的趋势——将他们未能发达视为性格、道德软弱和懒惰的问题。
moral.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

morality.en: Words that were more difficult to visualize, for example, “justice” or “ morality ” were considered to be more abstract.
morality.cn: 例如‘正义’或‘道德’这样难以形象化的词汇，算作是抽象词汇。

mortgage.en: Often there'll be a car loan and perhaps a mortgage, but credit cards often seem to be the gateway to debt related financial difficulties for many.
mortgage.cn: 通常情况下，人们会背负汽车贷款，或许还会背负房贷，但对许多人来说，信用卡似乎才是导致债务缠身、陷入财务困境的罪魁祸首。
mortgage.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

motion.en: They believe that constant motion somehow generates leadership as a byproduct.
motion.cn: 他们相信不断的行动会带来作为副产品的领导权。
motion.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

motivate.en: One strategy to be a good conversationalist is to motivate your partner to tell their own stories.
motivate.cn: 成为一名优秀的健谈者的一大方法就是激发谈话对象说出自己的故事。
motivate.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

mount.en: We stayed at Mount St Paul's Estate, a luxurious lodge run by the friendly Chris and Teara, both from Canada.
mount.cn: 我们住在圣保罗山庄，这是一家由来自加拿大的友善的克里斯和蒂娅拉经营的奢华旅馆。
mount.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

multiply.en: In the early days, as the supermarket multiplied, so did our suspicion of it.
multiply.cn: 早期，随着超市数量的激增，我们对超市的怀疑也与日俱增。
multiply.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

municipal.en: At the same time, public municipal pools were often closed, leaving low-income people nowhere to swim.
municipal.cn: 与此同时，公共市政游泳池经常关闭，导致低收入人群无处游泳。
municipal.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

muscular.en: The other is next to a muscular, fierce-looking man.
muscular.cn: 另一个人身旁是一名肌肉发达、神情凶猛的男子。
muscular.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 听力

mutual.en: Rather, we would not have been likely to spend enough time getting to know each other due to the lack of immediately visible mutual interests.
mutual.cn: 相反，由于缺乏显而易见的共同兴趣，我们不太可能花足够的时间互相了解。
mutual.source: 2012年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

mysterious.en: The quest to attain this mysterious state has dominated discussion around careers for years—especially for working parents.
mysterious.cn: 多年来，如何达到这种神秘状态一直是职业生涯讨论的焦点——尤其是对于职场父母而言。

myth.en: If these are the central characters of our story about poverty, what layers of perceptions, myths, and realities must we unearth to find meaningful solutions and support?
myth.cn: 如果这些人是我们关于贫穷的故事的核心人物，那么我们必须要揭露哪些层面的观念、谬论和现实去寻找重要的解决方案和支持呢？
myth.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

naked.en: Usually there is only one or two a year bright enough to be seen with the naked eye.
naked.cn: 通常一年中只有一两颗亮度足以用肉眼看到的太阳。
naked.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

naturally.en: For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally.
naturally.cn: 对于一些人而言，说服是与生俱来的能力，影响他人也就顺其自然。
naturally.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

naval.en: She was retired after her naval service.
naval.cn: 她在海军服役期满后退休了。
naval.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

necessarily.en: It may not necessarily give you a longer life, but there's a compelling body of work that it will give you more good years.
necessarily.cn: 它可能不会让你活得更久，但大量研究显示，它会让你的生活更有质量。
necessarily.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

neglect.en: It leads students to neglect their studies.
neglect.cn: 这会导致学生荒废学业。
neglect.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

negotiate.en: So it's important to know whether using an artificial intelligence agent might affect how we negotiate.
negotiate.cn: 所以，认识到运用人工智能代理在谈判中可能带来的影响至关重要。
negotiate.source: 2023年12月大学英语四级考试真题

nerve.en: Teeth have three layers, only one of which—the innermost layer of the tooth—can hurt, as that layer of the tooth contains both blood vessels and nerves .
nerve.cn: 牙齿有三层，其中只有最里面的一层会疼，因为那一层里既包含了血管又有神经。

network.en: The human brain has the ability to constantly form new networks and connections between brain cells.
network.cn: 人类大脑有能力不断在神经细胞之间建立新的网络和连接。

neutral.en: Since then, there have been a number of legal cases against companies involving paternity leave — including cases against JP Morgan Chase and Estée Lauder — which have helped put pressure on companies to make their parental leave policies gender neutral .
neutral.cn: 自那以后，出现了众多涉及陪产假的法律诉讼，其中就包括针对摩根大通和雅诗兰黛的案件。这些诉讼对企业构成了压力，促使它们的育儿假政策朝着性别中立的方向改进。

nevertheless.en: Nevertheless, while the woman's intention was to feed birds, it is clear that rats were also benefiting.
nevertheless.cn: 然而，虽然这位女士的本意是喂鸟，但很明显老鼠也从中受益。
nevertheless.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

nonsense.en: Bureaucrats regularly rewrite curriculums, talk nonsense about the theories of education, and require ever more administrators.
nonsense.cn: 官僚们经常重写课程，对教育理论一通胡说八道，并且要求更多的管理者。
nonsense.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

normally.en: They taught a series of dance moves to a group of patients with conditions like sleepwalking, in which the sleeper engages in the kind of physical movement that is normally inhibited during slumber.
normally.cn: 他们向一组梦游症患者教授了一系列舞步，在梦游的时候会完成一些在睡眠中往往被抑制的肢体动作。
normally.source: 2020年7月英语四级 第1套 阅读

notable.en: A notable criticism of the golden rule is that its application can lead to undesirable outcomes, when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles.
notable.cn: 有关黄金法则的一个值得注意的批评是，在法律和伦理的冲突中，它的应用可能会导致不良后果。
notable.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

notify.en: Harris, who became head teacher this year, said he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June.
notify.cn: 今年上任的校长哈里斯表示,他在六月份通过电子邮件向家长们通报了更新后的规定。
notify.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

nourishment.en: The corn provides nourishment across the globe.
nourishment.cn: 玉米为全球人民提供了重要的营养来源。
nourishment.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

numerous.en: Numerous studies have shown that drinking fruit juice doesn't make us consume any less of other foods throughout the day.
numerous.cn: 大量研究表明，喝果汁并不会减少我们一天中对其他食物的摄入量。
numerous.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

nursery.en: "They worry they'll be mistaken for grandparents, or that they'll need help getting up out of those little chairs in nursery school," says Joann Galst, a New York psychologist.
nursery.cn: 纽约心理学家乔安·加尔斯特说：“他们担心自己会被误认为是祖父母，或者担心自己在幼儿园里需要帮助才能从那些小椅子上站起来。”
nursery.source: 2006年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

objection.en: …to raise objections against another man's speech, it is a very easy matter…
objection.cn: 对他人的演说提出异议是很容易的事……
objection.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

objective.en: The design objective and the business commitment were to sportswear, and the distinctive traits were problem-solving ingenuity and realistic lifestyle applications.
objective.cn: 其设计目标和商业承诺是发展运动服装，注重解决问题的聪明才智和现实生活方式的应用是其独有的特点。
objective.source: 2017年6月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

observation.en: Share your observations about the world around you—interesting stories you heard or things you noticed—and you may be surprised by the universal connection they inspire.
observation.cn: 要分享你对周遭世界的观察所得——听到的趣闻或者注意到的事物——可能出乎你意料的是，它们能激发普遍的联结。
observation.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

obtain.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

occasion.en: We all take a little extra effort to look nice for special occasions.
occasion.cn: 在特殊场合，我们都会多花些心思让自己看起来更体面。
occasion.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

occasionally.en: Even worse, people will occasionally fight to do things that waste time.
occasionally.cn: 更糟糕的是，人们有时会为了做浪费时间的事情而争吵。
occasionally.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

occurrence.en: According to the study, the occurrence of foreign objects in children is generally attributed to curiosity.
occurrence.cn: 根据这项研究，儿童发生体内异物事件通常是因为他们好奇。
occurrence.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

odd.en: I genuinely find it odd, for if you nap properly, it’s like waking up from a full night’s sleep and you can double your day’s worth of concentration.
odd.cn: 我真的觉得这很奇怪，因为如果小睡质量很高，就像从一整夜的睡眠中醒来一样，你可以让你一天的注意力加倍。
odd.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

offend.cn: 他们可能会感到被冒犯。
offend.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

offensive.en: It is possible that your future husband will find this choice offensive.
offensive.cn: 你未来的丈夫可能会觉得这个选择冒犯了他。
offensive.source: 2023年3月大学英语四级考试真题

omit.en: Obviously you will still be you even if you've taken on your husband's last name and omitted yours entirely.
omit.cn: 即使你随了丈夫的姓，完全舍弃了自己的姓氏，你显然还是你自己。
omit.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

operation.en: It minimizes the use of controversial pesticides in its operations.
operation.cn: 它在经营中尽量减少使用存在争议的农药。
operation.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

optimism.en: In fact many experts argue that the most important 21st-century skills aren't related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity; skills like imagination, problem-finding and problem-solving, teamwork, optimism, patience and the ability to experiment and take risks.
optimism.cn: 事实上，许多专家认为，21世纪最重要的技能与特定技术或主题无关，而与创造力有关，如想象力、发现问题和解决问题的能力、团队合作、乐观、耐心，以及做实验和冒险的能力。
optimism.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

optimistic.en: An optimistic vision of vegan foods becoming mainstream.
optimistic.cn: 对素食食品成为主流的乐观展望。
optimistic.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

orbit.en: The tour saw him control a robot on Earth, remotely from orbit .
orbit.cn: 在太空任务中，他曾从轨道上远程控制地球上的机器人。

orchestra.en: Even so, it can be difficult for those who do not study music theory to see this as an indicator, since it is subtle and just shows the impact symphonic orchestras have had on society's taste in music.
orchestra.cn: 然而，对于那些没有学习音乐理论的人来说，这种影响很难察觉，因为它非常微妙，只是显示了交响乐团对社会音乐品味的塑造。
orchestra.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

organism.en: All living organisms on Earth are exposed to a 24-hour day-night cycle.
organism.cn: 地球上所有生物都受到24小时昼夜循环的影响。
organism.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

orient.en: Proto-Indo­ European was decimally oriented because, as in so many cultures, our ancestors' hands served as the gateway to the realization that "five fingers on one hand is the same as five fingers on the other".
orient.cn: 原始印欧语系适应十进制的原因是，在众多文化中，我们祖先的手让人们首次认识到 “一只手上的五根手指和另一只手上的五根手指是等量的”。
orient.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

orientation.en: They hit me right out of gate with a $160 fee to attend my freshman orientation , a price which does not include the cost of travel to and from the District.
orientation.cn: 刚开学，他们就收了我160美元的新生迎新费用，这还不包括往返学区的路费。

originate.en: It may have initially originated in individuals linked by blood.
originate.cn: 它最初可能起源于有血缘关系的个体之间。

ounce.en: The fifth largest city in the US passed a significant soda tax proposal that will levy 1.5 cents per liquid ounce on distributors.
ounce.cn: 美国第五大城市通过了一项意义重大的苏打饮料税提案，将对经销商征收每液体盎司1.5美分的税。
ounce.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

outbreak.en: Amid all the election drama, air pollution problems, and disease outbreaks, five tourists' good work is being spread online.
outbreak.cn: 在选举风波、空气污染问题和疾病爆发的背景下，五位游客的善举正在网上传播。
outbreak.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

outcome.en: Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior.
outcome.cn: 哈里斯认为,加强校服管理改善了学生的学业表现和行为规范。
outcome.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

outlet.en: By allowing employees to donate their time during work hours, the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment without affecting personal time.
outlet.cn: 通过允许员工在工作时间参与志愿服务，工作场所成为员工实现个人成就感的渠道，同时不占用个人时间。
outlet.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

outset.en: U.S. government officials outset to approve a mission by privately held space company-Moon Express to travel outside of the earth orbit in late 2017.
outset.cn: 2017 年底，美国政府官员开始批准私营太空公司 Moon Express 执行一项飞出地球轨道的任务。
outset.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

oval.en: Eggs have an oval shape appealing to artists.
oval.cn: 鸡蛋呈椭圆形，这很受艺术家们的喜爱。
oval.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

overall.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

overhead.en: It's like fixing up an airplane engine and ignoring that the pilot is on his third drink at the bar and a massive storm is overhead.
overhead.cn: 这就像是修理了飞机引擎，却忽视了飞行员在酒吧喝了第三杯酒，而一场剧烈的风暴就在上空。
overhead.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

overlook.en: There's a social dimension to health that we've completely overlooked in our efforts to find the best and most cutting-edge medical care.
overlook.cn: 在我们努力寻找最好和最尖端的医疗保健时，我们完全忽略了"健康"尤其社会层面。
overlook.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

overseas.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

overwhelm.en: I'm a bit overwhelmed with the amount of data I still need to collect to finish my thesis, but I still need to relax sometimes.
overwhelm.cn: 我还有大量的数据需要收集才能完成论文，这让我有点不知所措，但我还是需要偶尔放松一下。

overwhelming.en: By comparing identical twins, who share nearly 100 percent of their genes, and non-identical twins, who share about half, researchers have found overwhelming evidence for genetic effects on behaviors.
overwhelming.cn: 通过比较几乎共享全部基因的同卵双胞胎与约共享一半基因的异卵双胞胎，研究人员找到了大量基因对行为产生影响的有力证据。
overwhelming.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

owe.en: Coal prices also are low, owing to over-supply and the scaling-down of demand...
owe.cn: 由于供应过剩和需求缩减，煤炭价格也很低……

ownership.en: However, people did report a few disadvantages to pet ownership These included difficulty traveling and financial strains. 6% of pet owners said they'd fallen or injured themselves as a result of having a pet.
ownership.cn: 然而，人们也指出了养宠物的一些不利因素，包括旅行困难和经济负担。6%的宠物主人表示，他们因为养宠物而跌倒或伤到自己。
ownership.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

pace.en: They are advertised as a way for adults to finish their education and students to learn the material at their own pace—it is far more compatible for people with busy schedules.
pace.cn: 他们被宣传为一种让成年人完善自身教育、学生根据自己节奏学习教学内容的方式——非常适合日程忙碌的人群。
pace.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

pack.en: One had to quit abruptly on a given day, going from about a pack a day to zero.
pack.cn: 一组要在指定的一天突然戒烟，从一天一包变为一根也不抽。
pack.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

package.en: There is another depressing reality hidden within even the largest financial aid packages: Colleges often offer the most generous packages during freshman year as a way to attract new students.
package.cn: 即使是金额最高的助学金计划，也隐藏着另一个令人沮丧的现实：大学通常在大一期间提供最慷慨的助学金计划，以此来吸引新生。
package.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

pad.en: Heat from an electric pad or a warm bath can also help.
pad.cn: 电热垫或热水澡的热气也可以有所帮助。
pad.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

painful.en: Yet, there are valid reasons boredom may feel so painful .
painful.cn: 然而，无聊可能会让人感到痛苦，这是有合理理由的。

panel.en: I wish to enquire about solar panel installations.
panel.cn: 我想问问安装太阳能板的事情。
panel.source: 2020年12月大学英语四级考试真题

panic.en: The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living.
panic.cn: 校服价格可能让生活成本高企的家庭倍感压力。
panic.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

parade.en: About 100 current and past members of the dance group—which has been performing since 1956 will be among the 220 groups marching through Chinatown in Manhattan for the 18th Lunar New Year Parade on February 5.
parade.cn: 约100名自1956年以来一直活跃的舞蹈团体成员，将参加2月5日举行的第18届农历新年游行，该活动将在曼哈顿唐人街举行，共有220个团体参与。
parade.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

paragraph.en: What do we learn about American society from the first paragraph?
paragraph.cn: 从第一段中我们能了解到美国社会的哪些信息？
paragraph.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

parallel.en: While you need to employ both to get to a finished result, they cannot work in parallel no matter how much we might like to think so.
parallel.cn: 虽然你需要同时运用这两种方法来达到最终结果，但它们不能并行工作，无论我们多么希望如此。
parallel.source: 2007年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

parental.en: It doesn’t include the temptation to run from society or make an excuse to avoid one’s obligations — such as life-saving medical work or the parental obligation to buy groceries.
parental.cn: 它既不诱惑大家远离社会，也不制造借口逃避义务——比如拯救生命的医疗工作或父母购买食品杂货的义务。
parental.source: 2020年12月大学英语六级考试真题

parliament.en: Part of remedying this social disease would be for parliament to pass a “right to grow” law, allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens.
parliament.cn: 要解决这一社会问题，一个可行的办法是让议会通过"种植权"法案。该法案将允许民众把闲置的公共空间改造成蔬果园，这不失为一种有效的应对之策。
parliament.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

partial.en: Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams.
partial.cn: 澳大利亚最大的金矿之一的其中一个矿坝发生部分墙体坍塌，导致该矿周五不得不暂时停止运营。
partial.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

partially.en: In part, this reflects the fact that official campsites have been wholly or partially closed, or are overflowing in a summer when fewer people are going abroad.
partially.cn: 部分原因是，官方露营地全部或部分关闭，或者在夏季出国旅行的人较少的情况下人满为患。

participate.en: That and other Alzheimer's- related studies are always looking for volunteers to participate, he said.
participate.cn: 他表示，其他与阿尔茨海默病相关的研究也一直在寻求志愿者参与。
participate.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

particularly.en: You'd expect that people who are particularly sensitive to the bitter taste of caffeine would drink less coffee, said study senior researcher Marilyn Cornelis.
particularly.cn: “你或许会认为，对咖啡因苦味格外敏感的人会少喝咖啡，”研究资深作者玛丽琳·科内利斯说。

passive.cn: 被动学习也能创造知识。
passive.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

pat.en: The music would sound not quite right: attempts to pat the beat off just so.
pat.cn: 音乐听起来不太对：试着这样打打节拍。

pattern.en: To arrive at this conclusion, the researchers examined the linguistic patterns of men and women in over 600, 000 blog posts written on websites.
pattern.cn: 为了得出这一结论，研究者们调查了网站上超过六十万篇男女博客文章的语言模式。
pattern.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

paw.en: Some owners even shower with their Savannah Cats, presenting a water bowl to Savannah may also prove a challenge, as some will promptly begin to bat all the water out of the bowl until it is empty using their front paws.
paw.cn: 有些主人甚至会和他们的萨凡纳猫一起洗澡，给萨凡纳猫准备水碗也可能是一个挑战，因为有些萨凡纳猫会立即用前爪把碗里的水全部拍出来，直到碗空为止。
paw.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

peculiar.en: To illustrate people's peculiar shopping behavior.
peculiar.cn: 为了说明人们独特的购物行为。

penalty.cn: 同时还会处以300美元的罚款。

perceive.en: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
perceive.cn: 一项调查显示，89%的员工认为组织志愿活动的公司能创造更好的工作环境，75%的员工表示志愿服务对他们的身心健康至关重要。
perceive.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

perception.en: "Hiring managers have a strong perception bias against 45, job candidates — they believe that members of this age group have poor skills and low adaptability," Generation's analysts report.
perception.cn: "招聘经理对45岁以上的求职者存在强烈的认知偏见——他们认为这个年龄段的人技能欠佳、适应能力差，"Generation的分析师在报告中指出。
perception.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

perfection.en: But if gravity is removed, the beans float around in a heated oven, receive 360 degrees of evenly distributed heat and roast to near perfection.
perfection.cn: 但如果去除重力，咖啡豆会在加热的烤箱中漂浮，接受360度均匀分布的热量，然后烘烤到近乎完美。
perfection.source: 2021年6月大学英语四级考试真题

perform.en: Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.
perform.cn: 我们每天的行为中，几乎有一半是基于习惯而非决策。因此，一旦形成了正确的习惯，这些任务便会自动化地日复一日地被执行。
perform.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

peril.en: Yet, there are signs of peril within American higher education.
peril.cn: 然而，美国高等教育中存在着危险的迹象。

period.en: Sadly, the data also showed face-to-face socializing and sports activity had declined over the period covered by the survey.
period.cn: 遗憾的是，数据还显示，在调查期间，人们面对面的社交活动和体育活动都有所减少。
period.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

periodic.en: Online time has doubled since 2006, and social media use has moved from a periodic activity to a daily one in the same period.
periodic.cn: 2006年以来，上网时间翻了一番；与此同时，社交媒体的使用也从定期活动变成了日常活动。
periodic.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

permission.en: It would make sense that wild campers need to ask for permission to camp from landowners, especially outside Scotland, where the law is far more restrictive.
permission.cn: 在苏格兰以外的地区，野营者应当向地主申请露营许可，因为这些地区的法律更为严格。
permission.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

persist.en: Researchers found that enjoyment rather than importance enabled people to persist in their goals.
persist.cn: 研究者发现，享受过程而非重视程度，是使人们坚持目标的关键因素。
persist.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

personnel.en: There is a growing shortage of medical personnel.
personnel.cn: 医疗人员短缺问题日益严重。
personnel.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

pessimistic.en: In the last seven years, Americans have grown more pessimistic about the power of education to lead to success.
pessimistic.cn: 在过去的七年里，美国人对教育能否带来成功越来越悲观。
pessimistic.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

petroleum.en: A rapid increase in U.S. petroleum chemical production.
petroleum.cn: 美国石油化工产品产量迅速增长。

philosopher.en: One American philosopher stated that addressing the needs of the poor and vulnerable is about more than money – it is mostly about creating conditions under which prosperity and opportunity can thrive.
philosopher.cn: 一位美国哲学家指出，解决贫困和弱势群体的需求不仅仅是金钱的问题，更重要的是创造条件，使繁荣和机遇得以蓬勃发展。

photography.en: In support of that suggestion, a 2014 study by Denise C. Park of the University of Texas at Dallas and colleagues demonstrated that learning to knit or do digital photography enhanced memory function in older adults.
photography.cn: 为了支持这一观点，德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校的 Denise C. Park 及其同事在 2014 年进行的一项研究表明，学习编织或进行数码摄影可以增强老年人的记忆功能。
photography.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

pierce.en: She was pierced by a chicken bone.
pierce.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

pit.en: While digging two pits at a site in the central plains of China, scientists discovered fragments from pots and vessels.
pit.cn: 在挖掘中国中原地区某个遗址的两个地坑时，科学家们发现了罐子和容器的碎片。

plastic.en: Plastics have for years been used to make nearly everything that surrounds us, but along the way they escaped the confines of packaging and objects and settled in the environment, the food we eat and the air we breathe.
plastic.cn: 多年来，塑料被用于制造我们周围几乎所有的东西，但在这个过程中，塑料突破了包装和物品的界限，进入了环境、我们吃的食物和我们呼吸的空气中。
plastic.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

pledge.en: First Minister Nicola Sturgeon welcomed the pledge and said: "Today's announcement between ScottishPower and Glasgow City Council—to make Glasgow the UK's first net-zero city—is a very welcome step.
pledge.cn: 首席大臣尼古拉·斯特金对这一承诺表示欢迎，他说：“苏格兰电力公司和市议会宣布，格拉斯哥将成为英国第一个净零排放城市，这是令人欣喜的一步。
pledge.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

plug.en: It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.
plug.cn: 这仅仅意味着，当我们引入负互惠变量时，性别差距就消失了。
plug.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

poison.en: In fact, farmers used to poison them in large numbers.
poison.cn: 实际上，农民曾经大量毒杀它们（野鸭）。
poison.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

politics.en: Politics interferes with serious scientific debate.
politics.cn: 政治干扰了严肃的科学辩论。
politics.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

poll.en: People looking to stay well as they age may want to adopt a pet animal, according to new data from the University of Michigan National Poll on Healthy Aging.
poll.cn: 根据密歇根大学关于健康老龄化的全国民意调查的新数据，希望随着年龄增长保持健康的人可能会考虑收养一只宠物。
poll.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

popularity.en: Another reason for fruit juice's recent popularity is the argument that it can help to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body.
popularity.cn: 果汁近期流行的另一个原因是有人认为它能帮助排出体内的毒素或有害物质。
popularity.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

portion.en: "The best example is five a day, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day.
portion.cn: “最好的例子就是每天五份，也就是建议每天至少摄入五份水果和蔬菜。”
portion.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

pose.en: It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.
pose.cn: 它能降低食用肉类带来的各种健康风险。
pose.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

possess.en: One who enjoys playing games that require management skills to win might possess more qualities of a manager.
possess.cn: 喜欢玩需要管理技巧才能获胜的游戏的人，可能更具备管理者的素质。
possess.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

possibility.en: Crises, after all, have a way of opening people's eyes to possibilities.
possibility.cn: 毕竟，危机总能让人们看到新的可能性。
possibility.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

preach.en: Thomas, now a speaker and author of several books, also created small, independently-run residences with their own bedrooms and bathrooms, and he has been preaching a singular message that getting old is not a bad thing.
preach.cn: 托马斯现在是一名演说家，也是几本书的作者，他还建造了独立经营的小型（养老）住宅，有独立的卧室和卫生间，他一直在宣扬一个独特的信息，即变老并不是一件坏事。
preach.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

precise.en: Whether you are taking a DNA test to build your extended DNA family tree, or want precise information on inborn health conditions, it is important to understand how accurate genetic tests are, and what information we can rely upon.
precise.cn: 无论你是通过DNA测试来构建家族谱系,还是想获取先天健康状况的精确信息,了解基因检测的准确性以及哪些信息可以信赖都至关重要。
precise.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

precision.en: In a million words written over 20 years, he captured the full range of human emotions and conflicts with a precision that remains sharp today.
precision.cn: 他在用二十多年写下的百万文字中，精确地刻画了人类情感和矛盾的所有方面，其精确程度用于今日仍然十分犀利。
precision.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prediction.en: Keynes’s prediction of a shorter working week rests on the idea that the standard of living would continue rising for everyone.
prediction.cn: 凯恩斯预测工作周将缩短，这一预测建立在一个观点上：生活标准将持续为所有人提高。
prediction.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

preferable.en: What should people take into consideration in deciding on the most preferable protein intake?
preferable.cn: 人们在决定最佳蛋白质摄入量时应该考虑哪些因素？
preferable.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

pregnant.en: She quit her job when she became pregnant, but is now interested in returning to work.
pregnant.cn: 她怀孕后就辞职了，但现在想要回归职场。

prejudice.en: Problems with this technique include the fact that it can lead to errors and prejudice.
prejudice.cn: 这种技巧的问题包括它可能会导致错误和偏见。
prejudice.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 听力

preliminary.en: A preliminary review of Mexico’s taxation found a fall in purchases of taxed drinks as well as a rise in sales of untaxed and healthier drinks.
preliminary.cn: 对墨西哥税收的初步审查发现，被征税的酒类购买数量有所下降，同时，没被征税的、相对更加有益健康的饮品的购买量有所增加。
preliminary.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

prescribe.en: When doctors prescribe medicine for people, they rarely consider the best time to take it.
prescribe.cn: 医生给病人开药时，很少考虑最佳服药时间。
prescribe.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prescription.en: But UCLA pediatrician Carlos Lerner acknowledged that the pediatricians' new prescription may meet with skepticism from parents, who are anxious for advice on how to give their kids a leg up in the world.
prescription.cn: 但加州大学洛杉矶分校儿科医生卡洛斯·勒纳承认，儿科医生们的新建议可能会遭到家长的质疑，他们急于寻求如何让孩子在社会上更有优势的建议。
prescription.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

presence.en: This research found college students were more likely to choose healthy food in the presence of an observer of a different race as opposed to an observer from their own race.
presence.cn: 这项研究发现，在其他人种观察者的在场下，大学生们更倾向于选择健康食物，相比之下，同种族观察者的在场就没有这种效果。
presence.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

presentation.en: For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.
presentation.cn: 关于演示报告，我会带上我自己的笔记本电脑，并连接到投影仪上。
presentation.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

preservation.en: It applies to the preservation of pandas too.
preservation.cn: 这同样适用于熊猫的保护。
preservation.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

pretty.en: It's pretty incredible how it has managed to hijack the genes of the algae on which it feeds.
pretty.cn: 它窃取了它赖以生存的藻类的基因，这种方式相当难以置信。
pretty.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（一）

prevail.en: With a literacy rate in some parts of Africa at only 22.6%, farmers are often "underpaid for their produce because they might be unaware of the prevailing prices," says Francis Dittoh, a researcher behind Mr Meteo, a speech-based weather information service.
prevail.cn: 非洲某些地区的识字率只有 22.6%，农民往往“因为不了解当前的价格而无法获得应有的农产品报酬”，语音天气信息服务 Mr Meteo 的研究员 Francis Dittoh 表示。
prevail.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prevention.en: Activities helpful in the prevention of Alzheimer's also prevent heart disease.
prevention.cn: 有助于预防阿尔茨海默病的活动也有助于预防心脏病。

previous.en: The authors noted that previous research revealed gender differences in attitudes towards family and career.
previous.cn: 作者指出，先前的研究揭示了在家庭和职业态度上的性别差异。
previous.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

primarily.en: Therefore, patients are directed to take most drugs during the morning or evening primarily to ensure compliance.
primarily.cn: 因此，医生通常会让患者在早晨或晚上服药，主要是为了确保用药依从性。
primarily.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

primary.en: They leaned toward wanting primary responsibility for such tasks.
primary.cn: 他们倾向于希望主要负责这类任务。
primary.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

prime.en: When he returned in 1977 to try again, he was largely regarded as past his prime.
prime.cn: 1977年Red Rum重返赛场争夺冠军时，众人普遍认为它已过巅峰。
prime.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

primitive.en: The primitive tools early humans used tell a lot about their life, but my favorite is the coin collection.
primitive.cn: 早期人类使用的原始工具能揭示他们生活的许多信息，但我最喜欢的还是钱币收藏。

principle.en: The findings show: In principle, most people view it more when workers are replaced by other people than by robots or intelligent software.
principle.cn: 研究结果表明：原则上，大多数人更倾向于认为工人被其他人取代，而不是被机器人或智能软件取代。
principle.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

prior.en: Absorbing new information is helpful in making better decisions prior to action.
prior.cn: 吸收新信息有助于在行动前做出更好的决策。

priority.en: When making decisions, we give priority to our current frame of mind without thinking much of the consequences.
priority.cn: 在做决策时，我们往往会优先考虑自己当前的心理状态，而忽略了可能带来的后果。
priority.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

probable.en: The most probable reason for the popularity of plastic lunch boxes is that they are less expensive.
probable.cn: 塑料饭盒受欢迎最可能的原因是它们价格比较便宜。
probable.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

proceed.en: Ultimately, misleading results will be corrected as science proceeds; however, this process takes time.
proceed.cn: 最终，科学的发展会纠正那些误导性的结果；然而，这一过程需要时间。
proceed.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

productive.en: In a busy world, being busy doesn't stand out, nor does it mean productive, creative, accomplished, or professional.
productive.cn: 在这个忙碌的世界中，忙碌并不能让你脱颖而出，也不代表你就是高效、富有创造性、成就卓越或专业。
productive.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

productivity.en: There would be no mystery in this if Keynes had been wrong about the power of technology to increase the economy’s productivity, which he thought would lead to a standard of living “between four and eight times as high as it is today.”
productivity.cn: 如果凯恩斯对技术增强经济生产力的观点是错误的，那么这并不奇怪。他曾预测这会使得生活水平提升至今日的四至八倍。
productivity.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

professional.en: Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.
professional.cn: 科学研究现在表明，恰当的着装可能会在我们的职业和个人生活中带来额外优势。
professional.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

profit.cn: 所有收益都用于慈善事业。

profound.en: “We’ve seen profound changes in the last decades in what we eat largely as a result of international trade, and I think that trend toward more diversification will continue,” Janis says.
profound.cn: “在过去的几十年里，由于国际贸易的影响，我们的饮食结构发生了深刻变革。我认为，这种多元化的趋势将会继续下去，”贾尼斯表示。
profound.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

progressive.en: San Jose had social mobility comparable to Denmark’s and Canada’s and higher than other progressive cities such as Boston and Minneapolis.
progressive.cn: 圣何塞的社会流动性堪比丹麦和加拿大，比波士顿和明尼阿波利斯等进步城市还高。
progressive.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prohibit.en: It is prohibited to feed any wild animals including birds in Rhode Island City.
prohibit.cn: 在罗德岛市，禁止喂食任何野生动物，包括鸟类。
prohibit.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

prohibition.en: In those where ties to family and community are strong, lifelong marriages can be promoted by practices such as the cultural prohibition of divorce and arranged marriages that are seen as a contract between two families, not just two individuals.
prohibition.cn: 在家庭和社区纽带坚固的地方，一辈子的婚姻可以通过诸如离婚为文化所禁止、由两个家庭签订而非个人决定的包办婚姻等惯例来促进。
prohibition.source: 2013年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

projector.en: For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector .
projector.cn: 为了做演示，我会自带笔记本电脑，并连接到他们的投影仪上。

promote.en: According to evolutionary scientists, cooperative behavior may have evolved first among relatives to promote the continuation of their genetic line.
promote.cn: 据进化科学家分析，合作行为最初可能在亲属之间演化形成，以促进基因血脉的延续。
promote.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prompt.en: Fake holiday villa websites prompt warning
prompt.cn: 虚假度假别墅网站会发出警告
prompt.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

proper.en: More than 80% of those cases can be attributed to contact with contaminated water and a lack of proper sanitation.
proper.cn: 超过80%的病例与接触受污染的水源和缺乏适当的卫生设施有关。
proper.source: 2016年6月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

property.en: They should be Googling the property, and looking at websites like Google Maps and Street View to see if it’s there.
property.cn: 他们应该用谷歌搜索相应房产，并在谷歌地图、街景这样的网站上查看它是否在那里。
property.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

proportion.en: The labor market is likely cooling, because even a shortage of workers isn't overcoming the historic imbalance between employers and employees in the US: the volume of income that workers take home as a proportion of what the US economy produces is still falling.
proportion.cn: 劳动力市场可能正在冷却，因为即使劳动力短缺，也无法克服美国雇主与雇员之间的历史性失衡：工人收入占美国经济产出的比重仍在下降。
proportion.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

proportional.en: So the figures for the growth of towns and cities represent proportional growth of unemployment and underemployment, a growth in the number of hopeless and despairing parents and starving children.
proportional.cn: 因此，城镇和城市的增长数据反映了失业和就业不足的比例增长，也就是绝望的父母和饥饿儿童数量的增长。
proportional.source: 2007年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

prose.en: With a blending of free-flowing confessional prose and scholarly research found in 461 notes, Kelli met my expectations that her ideas and ideals would be sound and singular.
prose.cn: 这461篇笔记中我发现一种自由流动的自白式散文和学术研究的融合，凯莉达到了我的期望：她的想法和理想将是明智且独特的。
prose.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prospect.en: Playing games casually is unlikely to help your career prospects.
prospect.cn: 随便玩玩游戏不太可能对你的职业发展有所帮助。
prospect.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

prospective.en: A new bill in the Ohio legislature would require state public colleges and universities to send prospective students a packet of information.
prospective.cn: 俄亥俄州议会正在审议一项新法案，该法案将要求州内公立高校向潜在学生提供一套详细信息。
prospective.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

protective.en: So it’s really a protective mechanism more than anything else.
protective.cn: 所以，相比其他而言，这真的是一种保护机制。
protective.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

protein.en: It's also about reducing the amount of grain carbs and protein and fats in our diet, and increasing fibre.
protein.cn: 这也关乎减少饮食中的谷物碳水化合物、蛋白质和脂肪的摄入量，同时增加膳食纤维。
protein.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

protest.en: Taking out those parking spots, as they argued at protests and in letters to the city council, would ruin stores and restaurants along Skillman.
protest.cn: 正如他们在抗议活动和致市议会的信中所说的，取消这些停车位会毁掉技能大街沿线的商店和餐馆。
protest.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

proverb.en: Many American proverbs stress the value of guarding time, using it wisely, and setting and working toward specific goals.
proverb.cn: 许多美国谚语强调珍惜时间、明智地利用时间以及设定并努力实现具体目标的重要性。
proverb.source: 2012年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

provoke.en: New technologies always provoke generational panic, which usually has more to do with adult fears than with the lives of teenagers.
provoke.cn: 新技术往往激起一代人的恐慌，而这种恐慌通常更多地来源于成年人的担忧，而不是青少年的实际生活。
provoke.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

psychological.en: Such studies often also rely on careful psychological assessments and DNA analysis.
psychological.cn: 这类研究还常常借助细致的心理评估和DNA分析。
psychological.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

publication.en: In the 1970s through the 1990s, protein products remained visible but moved back somewhat with the dietary spotlight firmly fixed on low-calorie, low-fat, sugar-free snack foods and beverages following the publication of studies linking sugar and saturated fat consumption to heart disease.
publication.cn: 从20世纪70年代到90年代，虽然蛋白质产品仍然存在于市场，但其热度有所降低。这是因为一系列研究表明，糖分和饱和脂肪的摄入与心脏病有关，导致人们的饮食焦点转向了低热量、低脂肪和无糖的零食和饮料上。
publication.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

punch.en: Each film has an attractive lead, several expensive explosions, a few jokes to light in the mood, and numerous punches that land unrealistically well.
punch.cn: 每部电影都有一个吸引人的主角，几次耗资巨大的爆炸，几个可以点亮气氛的笑话，以及无数命中率不切实际的拳头。
punch.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

purchase.en: Emotion is what really drives the purchasing behaviors and also decision-making in general.
purchase.cn: 情感是驱动购买行为及一般决策的真正动力。
purchase.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

purity.en: In fact, New York's municipal water for more than a century was called the champagne of tap water and until recently considered among the best in the world in terms of both taste and purity.
purity.cn: 事实上，一个多世纪以来，纽约市的自来水一直被称为自来水中的香槟，直到最近，它在口感和纯度方面都被认为是世界上最好的自来水之一。
purity.source: 2006年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

qualification.en: Residents who met certain income qualifications could qualify for $1,200.
qualification.cn: 符合一定收入标准的居民可以获得1,200美元的资助。
qualification.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

qualify.en: Residents who met certain income qualifications could qualify for $1,200.
qualify.cn: 符合一定收入标准的居民可以获得1,200美元的资助。
qualify.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

quota.en: Sweden's rank in the report can largely be explained by its political quota system.
quota.cn: 瑞典在该报告中的排名主要可以用其政治方面的定额分配体制来解释。
quota.source: 2014年6月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

quotation.en: What can we conclude from Lao Zi's quotation?
quotation.cn: 从老子的引言中我们可以得出什么结论？
quotation.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

quote.en: "When you can quote a specific number like a fifth of the patients were able to quit, that's compelling. It gives them the encouragement, I think, to really go for it," Ferreira says.
quote.cn: 费雷拉还说：“当你能引用一个具体数字，比如五分之一的病人可以成功戒烟，这是很有说服力的。我认为这可以鼓励戒烟的人，让他们真正努力争取戒烟。”
quote.source: 2017年6月大学英语四级考试真题（二）

radar.en: Then, why is it that my radar showed you are going 45?
radar.cn: 那么，为什么我的雷达显示你的速度是45呢？
radar.source: 2012年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

radical.en: Avoiding radical change in one's career direction.
radical.cn: 避免职业方向发生剧烈变化。
radical.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

rage.en: This means they have overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject, ranging from rage to despair.
rage.cn: 这意味着他们对这个学科有着从愤怒到绝望的强烈消极情绪。
rage.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

raid.en: If they say they want leadership — why can't I point to my years of leading World of Warcraft raids?
raid.cn: 如果他们说需要领导力——那我为什么不能拿出自己多年带领《魔兽世界》团队突袭副本的经验？
raid.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

railroad.en: They will race each other to build a railroad model on the playground, with some students being forced to "work" longer and faster and at cheaper wages.
railroad.cn: 学生们可以在操场上比赛建造火车轨道模型，其中一些学生甚至被迫拿着低报酬，长时间高速地“工作”。
railroad.source: 2020年9月大学英语四级考试真题

rally.en: Today, the Earth Day Network, which rallies more than 20,000 partners and organizations in 190 countries, supports the Earth Day mission year-round.
rally.cn: 今天,地球日网络在190个国家联合了超过2万个合作伙伴和组织,全年支持地球日的使命。
rally.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

range.en: Chemical pesticides generally kill a much wider range of pests than any single natural pesticide.
range.cn: 化学农药通常可以杀死比任何单一天然农药更广泛的害虫。
range.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

rare.en: It's rare to find an island that really does feel undiscovered — but this is it.
rare.cn: 很少有岛屿能给人一种真正未被发现的感觉——但这里就是其中之一。
rare.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

rarely.en: This phenomenon has been observed several times but rarely studied properly.
rarely.cn: 这一现象虽已被多次注意到，却鲜有深入研究。
rarely.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

rational.en: Alter its per-pupil funding policy on a rational basis.
rational.cn: 理性地调整其人均资助政策。
rational.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

raw.en: Based on that timing, they indicate barley may have arrived in the region not as food, but as raw material for beer brewing.
